papers.title: Multiscale Transcriptomic Network Models of Parkinson's Disease at the Single Cell Level.
papers.summary: Using single-nucleus RNA-seq from Parkinson's disease substantia nigra, the authors build meta-cell-based multiscale gene regulatory networks (MCMNA) that overcome single-cell sparsity. Cell-type-specific co-expression modules, differential expression, and Bayesian causal networks identify putative driver genes and hierarchies, providing a framework for prioritizing molecular regulators and therapeutic targets in PD.

papers.title: Genome-wide CRISPR screening identified hemojuvelin as a non-neuronal receptor for the botulinum neurotoxin serotypes A and C.
papers.summary: A genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen identifies hemojuvelin (HJV), abundant in skeletal muscle, as a non-neuronal receptor for botulinum neurotoxins A and C. HJV's C-terminal region binds the toxin HCR WY loop; HJV knockout mice show reduced sarcolemma toxin enrichment and attenuated paralysis and lethality, refining in vivo toxin entry mechanisms.

papers.title: A near-complete quail genome identifies heterochromatin expansion and chromosome architecture remodeling.
papers.summary: A near-complete chromosome-level Japanese quail genome assembly (1.33 Gb) is up to 43% larger than prior versions, revealing extensive repeat accumulation and pericentromeric heterochromatin expansion on micro- and dot chromosomes. Transposable element accumulation reshaped chromatin architecture, histone marks, and interchromosomal contacts, with pronounced W chromosome heterochromatinization and quail-specific chromatin states.

papers.title: Bacterial endosymbiont suppresses detoxification through folate-mediated DNA methylation in Nilaparvata lugens.
papers.summary: The endosymbiont Arsenophonus nilaparvatae increases insecticide susceptibility of the brown planthopper via a folate-DNA methylation axis: enhanced folate biosynthesis elevates SAM/SAH ratio, increases NlDNMT3 expression and global 5mC, and promoter-methylates the detoxification gene NlCYP6ER1, reducing its transcription. Methylation inhibition reverses effects, suggesting folate metabolism as an insect-control target.

papers.title: Explainable AI-driven marker selection and development of EastFocus AISNPplex 61 assay for fine-scale biogeographical ancestry inference.
papers.summary: Combining SHAP explainability with recursive feature elimination, 58 ancestry-informative SNPs were built into EastFocus AISNPplex 61, a 6-dye allele-specific PCR multiplex with two Y-indels and amelogenin. Validated to 250-500 pg input and 1:7 mixtures, it distinguishes five continental populations (AUC 0.981-0.999) and intra-East Asian structure (AUC >0.940).

papers.title: Metabolic reprogramming of pathogenic CD4(+) T helper cells attenuates inflammatory bowel disease in mice.
papers.summary: Methyl pyruvate forces mitochondrial pyruvate metabolism in pathogenic Th1 cells, suppressing GSK3β, shifting metabolism from glycolysis to oxidative phosphorylation, lowering acetyl-CoA and histone H3 acetylation at cytokine genes, and inducing regulatory-like phenotype. IL-21 acts oppositely via GSK3β; pharmacologic GSK3β inhibition attenuates colitis, identifying a metabolic-epigenetic therapeutic axis for IBD.

papers.title: Combining TAG-72CAR with anti-MUC16CAR improves the potency of ovarian cancer treatment.
papers.summary: A combinatorial CAR T targeting TAG-72 (sialyl-TN, CD3ζ signaling) and MUC16 via K101 (4-1BB costimulation) kills MUC16+/TAG-72+ ovarian cancer cells while sparing MUC16+/TAG-72- cells in vitro, suppressing tumors in vivo. Compared with single K101 CAR T, TZ-KBB T cells expand better, persist longer, and show reduced exhaustion.

papers.title: Simplified in vitro generation of human gastruloids for modelling early development.
papers.summary: The authors optimize human gastruloid generation across four UK Stem Cell Bank hPSC lines: home-made N2B27 medium replaces commercial formulations, activin A is reduced to 15% of original, cell density titrated, GSK3 inhibitor addition delayed to aggregation onset, and TGFβ inhibitor added, yielding a simplified, economical, reproducible protocol producing three-germ-layer regionalized elongated gastruloids.

papers.title: Arterial endothelial expression of α2,8-linked Neu5Gc as a potential target for anti-xeno-antigen inflammation in Cmah-KO mice.
papers.summary: Using novel anti-Neu5Gc monoclonal antibodies, the authors characterize a xeno-autoantigen epitope enriched on arterial endothelium, identified as an α2,8-linked disialyl Neu5Gc structure. Intravenous per-acetylated ManNGc induces this epitope in Cmah-KO mice, providing a structural foundation for studying Neu5Gc-dependent vascular xenosialitis and its proposed role in atherosclerosis.

papers.title: CRB3 and ARP2/3 regulate cell biomechanical properties to set epithelial monolayers for collective movement.
papers.summary: CRB3, a apical polarity protein, regulates epithelial monolayer biomechanics during the symmetry breaking that precedes collective migration. CRB3 interacts with ARP2/3 and controls actin remodeling by modulating the Rho/Rac GTPase balance, acting upstream of Rac1 activation, linking polarity signaling to force generation in epithelial sheets.

papers.title: CelFDrive: Multimodal deep learning-assisted microscopy for automated detection of rare events.
papers.summary: CelFDrive integrates deep-learning classification of low-magnification fluorescence images with automated high-resolution 3D microscopy to detect and image rare cellular events. It reduced time to nominate prophase cells for light-sheet imaging over 30-fold, enabling kinetochore assembly ordering, and transferred across cell lines, DNA markers, and imaging setups.

papers.title: Population genetics, trait mapping and fungal pathogen surveillance using untargeted sequencing in timber rattlesnakes (Crotalus horridus).
papers.summary: Untargeted low-coverage sequencing of scale-clip DNA from 107 timber rattlesnakes jointly resolved population structure, trait association, and pathogen surveillance. Inbreeding is high in some populations; a GWAS locus containing ALDH4A1 underlies black-to-yellow color morph; Ophidiomyces ophidiicola loads track clinical disease signs, all from one minimally invasive workflow.

papers.title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of the Eurasian great grey owl, Strix nebulosa lapponica (Thunberg 1798).
papers.summary: A chromosome-level great grey owl genome assembly from two pseudo-haplotypes (1554/1242 Mb) places Z and W chromosomes, achieves BUSCO 99.2%, annotates ~18,500 protein-coding genes, and confirms diploid number 2n=82. ONT reads resolved conserved dot microchromosomes better than HiFi assemblies, establishing a reference for Strix chromosome evolution.

papers.title: Multi-locus genome-wide association analysis of grain yield, plant height, panicle length, and flowering time in the Senegalese pearl millet [Pennisetum glaucum (L.) R. Br.] germplasm.
papers.summary: Multi-locus GWAS of 137 Senegalese pearl millet genotypes, genotyped with 14,718 DArTseq SNPs, detected eleven marker-trait associations across six chromosomes for grain yield, plant height, panicle length, and flowering time. Candidate genes include an expansin, AP2/ERF transcription factor, auxin glucosyltransferase, and a chromosome-2 flowering locus near phytochrome C.

papers.title: Optimised fluorescence-activated nuclei sorting for epigenomic analysis of cortical cell types.
papers.summary: Optimized fluorescence-activated nuclei sorting protocols purify neuronal, oligodendrocyte, microglial, and other glial nuclei from adult and fetal human and mouse brain. FANS-isolated nuclei support DNA methylation, histone modification, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression assays, enabling cell-type-resolved multi-omic profiling that maximizes limited post-mortem tissue resources.

papers.title: The Genomic Equity Accessibility Framework (GEAF): A dimensionally consistent framework for modeling affordability and equity in genomic and regenerative therapies.
papers.summary: The authors audit the Genomic Equity Accessibility Framework, identify dimensional incompatibilities and unbounded output, and reconstruct GEAF' as a bounded 0-100 composite of six dimensionless components using multi-attribute utility theory. Tested on seven scenarios with Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis, it is presented as a transparent candidate policy framework, not a validated predictive tool.

papers.title: Shenling Qige Granules inhibit esophageal squamous cell carcinoma progression in TE-1 xenograft and cell-based models by modulating the DCN-TGF-β/Smad signaling axis.
papers.summary: Shenling Qige Granules, a traditional Chinese medicine preparation, inhibited esophageal squamous cell carcinoma growth in TE-1 xenografts and serum-treated cells. They increased decorin (DCN) expression, reduced Smad2/3 phosphorylation, promoted apoptosis and G0/G1 arrest; DCN knockdown attenuated these effects, implicating the DCN-TGFβ/Smad axis, with ursolic acid a candidate active compound.

papers.title: Identification of an atypical microRNA with sequence variation in the silkworm Bombyx mori.
papers.summary: A Bombyx mori strain with translucent larval skin carries a miR-3260 mutant with loop-structure deletion. Wild-type miR-3260 is highly expressed in corpora allata and upregulated by juvenile hormone, but neither wild-type nor mutant precursors undergo Dicer cleavage, suggesting miR-3260 is a JH-responsive non-coding RNA distinct from canonical microRNAs.

papers.title: GP-DHT: A dual-head transformer with supervised contrastive learning for shared-gene pretraining and single-cell GRN prediction.
papers.summary: GP-DHT is a single-cell gene regulatory network inference framework pretraining gene representations in a human-mouse shared gene space on BEELINE datasets. A dual-head transformer combining regulatory link classification with gene-pair supervised contrastive learning improves embedding separability and prediction in sparse data, with explicit reproducibility and leakage controls.

papers.title: Lactate dehydrogenase activity and carbohydrate metabolism under vanadium citrate exposure: Sex- and dose-dependent effects in rat tissues.
papers.summary: In Wistar rats, 36-38 days of vanadium citrate exposure produced sex- and dose-dependent lactate dehydrogenase changes without overt toxicity. Optimal modulating doses were 12.5 μg/kg for females and 3 μg/kg for males, with pancreas most affected at 50 μg/kg, reflecting insulin-like vanadium action plus citrate-mediated allosteric glycolysis inhibition.

papers.title: CfDNA methylation profiling in blood following moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury using brain cell type-enriched signatures: A pilot study.
papers.summary: Whole-genome bisulfite sequencing of neurons, astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, microglia, and vascular endothelial cells identified brain cell type-enriched methylation signatures. In a pilot of moderate-to-severe traumatic brain injury, brain-derived cfDNA methylation features in blood differed across acute, subacute, and chronic time points, nominating candidate cell-type-specific cfDNA biomarkers for TBI.

papers.title: The dynamics of piRNA expression in Blattella germanica ovaries.
papers.summary: Profiling piRNA dynamics across Blattella germanica ovarian maturation shows stable expression in previtellogenic ovaries and pronounced changes during vitellogenesis, where diversity drops as a subset of highly expressed piRNAs, predominantly LINE-mapping, is enriched. mRNA-derived piRNAs increase late in the cycle, suggesting piRNA regulation of transposons and genes during follicle maturation.

papers.title: Integrating deep learning model for precision design of MERS antibodies with augmented affinity against SARS-CoV-2.
papers.summary: A deep-learning protein engineering pipeline redirected three MERS-CoV antibodies toward the SARS-CoV-2 receptor-binding domain via a conserved site 2 epitope. ProteinMPNN-based redesign plus biophysical filtering produced variants including D12(T721E), MERS27(D722N), and JC57-14(S618G) with improved interface organization, stability, reduced aggregation, and lower predicted MHC presentation, supporting broad-spectrum coronavirus antibody development.
